  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  pins : List PinOb

/-- Leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (§74): an active pinning obligation covers it. -/
def S3.pin (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Bool := s.pins.any fun o => o.active && o.leaves.contains l

/-- Shape of the locals of `enterFrame` (§72) and of an allocation (§71.1): each element is an
optional structural parent (a place index) and a `kind`. Every element is owned by the holder
receiving the shape. -/
abbrev LocalShape := List (Option Nat × Nat)

/-- External contract `K` (§48, §80): `DeclaredDisjoint` on regions (§23, §61.3);
`SharedMutable` and `Pinned` on leaves (§68.1, §63.5); `ExternalDone` on dynamic pinning
obligations, by identity (§75); `Deallocable` on places (§70.2); `FreeCompat place auth` (§70.2);
`Satisfiable provider shape s` (§71). Obligations of `K` are hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → LocalShape → S3 → Prop

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along its origin chain (§42, §43). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of `x` (§44): the root reached along its origin chain, the last element of
`x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority (§42); as an anchor, a valid anchor (§44). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

/-- Decidability of `S3.Active` (§42, §44). -/
instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

/-- Current frame, the top of the stack (§39). -/
def S3.top (s : S3) : Nat := s.F.headD 0

/-! ## Decidable helpers -/

/-- Predicate on an optional value, `P y` for `some y` and `d` for `none`; used to read the
components of `S3` (§38). -/
def OptP {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) : Prop :=
  match o with
  | some y => P y
  | none => d

/-- Decidability of `OptP` (§38). -/
instance {α : Type} (o : Option α) (P : α → Prop) (d : Prop) [DecidablePred P] [Decidable d] :
    Decidable (OptP o P d) :=
  match o with
  | some y => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (P y))
  | none => inferInstanceAs (Decidable d)
instance (P : List Place) (src q : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedIn P src q) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ ownedIn_iff.symm

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Modes of the active descendants of `a` whose footprint covers leaf `p` (§43). -/
def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
  (List.range s.A.length).filterMap fun j =>
    match s.A[j]? with
    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
    | none => none

/-- Cases 2–4 of §43 for an active authority of own mode `m` covering the leaf, whose covering
active descendants have modes `ds`. -/
def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe

/-- `effective(s, a, l)` (§43, cases 1–4), computed per leaf. -/
def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
  | none => none

/-- Compatible effective modes for independent ordinary accesses: only `Observe`/`Observe`
(§50). -/
def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe

/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded (§43). -/
def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False

/-- Decidability of `Allows` (§43). -/
instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a` (§42), empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Adds an authority with fresh identity `s.A.length` (§42, §60). -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (§43) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt(s, a, m)` (§43): `a` is active, its own mode permits `m`, and it is held by
the current frame, or by a place `p` such that an authority itself exercisable at `m` has an
effective mode permitting `m` on every leaf of `p`. Inductive along the holder chain (§43), so no
holder cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m` read on a Boolean premise (decision procedure for §43). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43): the current frame has an authority exercisable at `m` whose
effective mode permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

/-- Decidability of `HasRight` (§43). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-- Authority `g` grounds the right `HasRight(s, m, q)` (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3: "the
exercisable authority on which that right rests"): it is exercisable at `m` and its effective mode
permits `m` on every leaf of `q`'s footprint. -/
def Grounds (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Prop :=
  g ∈ List.range s.A.length ∧ s.ExercisableAt g m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s g l) m

/-- Decidability of `Grounds` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) : Decidable (Grounds s m q g) := by
  unfold Grounds; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` is the grounding authority `g` or belongs to its origin chain (§63.4, §69.2,
§70.3: "the exercisable authority on which that right rests and its origin chain"). -/
def RightChain (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Prop := j = g ∨ j ∈ s.ancs g

/-- Decidability of `RightChain` (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (g j : Nat) : Decidable (RightChain s g j) := by
  unfold RightChain; infer_instance

/-! ## Dependencies and anchors (§44) -/

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (§44: dependencies of contained values
are accounted for transitively). -/

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
transitively. -/
def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance

/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance

/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D

/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : s.Usable src
  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source, except the
  authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over the source: some authority
  grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j
  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
  /-- §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst ∧ (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (§64) -/


/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `read` (§66). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Read3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s

/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §67.1: targeted leaves belong to usable places. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
  over the written leaves. -/
  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }

/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
transitively. -/
def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance

/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance

/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D

/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : s.Usable src
  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source, except the
  authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over the source: some authority
  grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j
  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
  /-- §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst ∧ (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (§64) -/


/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `read` (§66). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Read3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s

/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §67.1: targeted leaves belong to usable places. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
  over the written leaves. -/
  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }

/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops

/-!
# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability

Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/

/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
authority is valid, that is, active. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
      (y.active = true → x.active = true)

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-!
# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability

Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/

/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
authority is valid, that is, active. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
      (y.active = true → x.active = true)

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-! ## Usage scenarios W1, W2 (material §5b) -/

/-- Run of W1 (§72, §71, §67, §63; HandlePool v0.5, D.1–D.3, HP5-1): frame 1 with the allocator
0, the pool value 1, the handle leaves 2 and 3, and two locals of the shape of a node, 4 (fields 5,
6, 7) and 8 (fields 9, 10, 11); storage 12 owned by the pool value, with the nodes 13 (fields
`data` 14, `parent` 15, `child` 16) and 17 (fields 18, 19, 20); pool on 12, its `internal` the
root authority 6 of the storage. The two nodes are linked both ways (the child of the first, the
parent of the second), each through a `resolve Modify`, writes and `unresolve`; then a resolution
of the first node to write its data. The value of the second node is then removed (arbitration
Q21, along the path of the Q3 witness): `resolve Modify` (companion 13, entry 14), write of its
last field not yet written (20), `transfer` of the entry to the local 4, `unresolve`. Last,
`freeSlot` of the second node, still designated by the child field of the first. -/
def w1o : List COp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, pt 4, pt 4, pt 4, lf, pt 8, pt 8, pt 8],
  .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, pt 12, pt 13, pt 13, pt 13, pt 12, pt 17, pt 17, pt 17], .newPool 12 6,
  .allocSlot 0 2, .allocSlot 0 3,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .write 8 [14, 16], .unresolve 7,
  .resolve 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ .modify, .write 10 [18, 19], .unresolve 9,

/-!
# Corpus runner (test module)

A computable executor for the corpus cases of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: the
kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75) and the arena operations O17–O19 of Part XIV (§76–§78), over

registry). This module is a test module: no model module imports it.

* `Op`: one constructor per operation, with its arguments.

* `OpRel k L o`: the relation of the operation: the kernel relation `XStep` (§60–§75) with the

* `lrun`, `final`, `RunsTo`: a run from `LState.init statics` (§47) whose steps are all `ok` reaches
  a library-reachable state (`LReach`) whose kernel state is reachable (`Reachable`, §57).

`newArena` consults the arena registry and no other registry (§56: `others = []`): the library
states of these runs hold no administration other than arenas.

/-!
# Access kernel: source leaves after an accepted `transfer` (§63.4, decision Q17)

Owner decision Q17 (validated 2026-11-06): the exemption of §63.4, for "the exercisable authority
on which that right rests and its origin chain", is accepted. With `g` any authority grounding the
`Modify` right over `source` (`Grounds`, §43) and the grounding chain `RightChain s g` (§63.4),
after an accepted `transfer` (§63) from a reachable state (§57):

* (a) every active authority covering a source leaf lies in the grounding chain (§43, §50);

  `Moved` (§41, §63 `ok` effect, §63.3 disjointness); a write (O10, §67) or a shared write
  (O11, §68) of a source leaf through a strict origin-chain ancestor of `g` is rejected, `g`
  being an active `Modify` descendant covering the leaf (§43 case 3); a second `transfer` of the
  source is rejected (§63.3).

A write or shared write of a source leaf through `g` itself is accepted in some reachable run
(`TransferSourceWitness.write_through_ground_accepted`): §67 and §68 have no `Init` precondition
and `Moved` forbids reads only (§41, §53).

authority is created or duplicated; §63.4). -/
theorem transfer_rightChain (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :

  funext g j; simp only [RightChain, (transfer_skel s src dst).ancs]

rejected. -/
theorem transfer_source_anc_writeShared_rejected {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) {ls : List Nat} (hls : l ∈ ls) {x : Nat}
    (hx : x ∈ s'.ancs g)
    {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : WriteSharedStep k x ls s' o) : o = .reject :=

`src`, and every authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over `src` before the step:

    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) :

      (∀ (a : Nat) (o : Outcome3 S3), Read3Step a ls s' o → o = .reject) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s'.ancs g, ∀ o : Outcome3 S3, Write3Step x ls s' o → o = .reject) ∧

  ⟨transfer_source_cover_chain_of_i1 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).2.1.1.1 ht hg,

    fun _ hx _ h => transfer_source_anc_writeShared_rejected ht hg hl hls hx h⟩⟩

open Examples

    Reachable K0 st (write3Eff t1 [0]) := by
  have ht : TransferStep K0 0 1 s0 (.ok t1) := .ok (by decide)
  have hw : Write3Step 0 [0] t1 (.ok (write3Eff t1 [0])) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨fun _ _ h => h.elim, by decide, .init, ht, by decide, by decide, by decide, hw,

content.text:
Les cinq premiers points sont faits et commités en local. Le build complet passe sans avertissement et la recherche de `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom`/`native_decide` ne trouve rien. Rien n'est poussé.

**Ce qui est prouvé**
- **Q3** : `freeSlot` est maintenant une étape `write` du noyau sur les feuilles de la valeur du pool, suivie de la mise à jour du registre.
  - (a) est `freeSlot_meta_leaves`, (b) est `freeSlot_kernel_write`, sans hypothèse `Init` préalable, et (c) est `freeSlot_abstract_update`.
  - `meta_write_not_identity` va maintenant jusqu'à un `freeSlot` accepté où la feuille `Moved` devient `Init`.
- **Q17 (a)** est prouvé sur les états atteignables, pour toute autorité fondatrice.
- **StaticsOK (a)** : toute déclaration conforme à §47/§49 a une renumérotation StaticsOK qui garde l'ordre des champs (`StaticsConf.exists_renumber`). La réciproque est prouvée aussi. Ce théorème utilise `Classical.choice`, qui fait partie des axiomes admis.
- **H49** : les témoins sont gardés, et la justification par I2 est maintenant vérifiée dans le théorème : l'effet v0 laisse 8 actif avec son origine 5 inactive, et de même 7 avec 6.

**Q17 (b) est faux pour une partie, et je ne l'ai pas reformulé.**
- Les lectures sont rejetées par toute autorité. Les écritures et écritures partagées sont rejetées si elles passent par un ancêtre strict de l'autorité fondatrice.
- Une écriture qui passe par l'autorité fondatrice elle-même est acceptée. Elle réinitialise la feuille `Moved`, ce que §67 et §68 autorisent puisqu'ils n'exigent pas `Init`.
- Le contre-exemple est `TransferSourceWitness.write_through_ground_accepted`, et la même chose se produit dans W2 (11 sur le champ 12, 7 sur le champ 9). W2 note un **MISMATCH**.
- C'est à vous de choisir : restreindre (b) aux lectures et aux ancêtres stricts, ou ajouter une règle dans la spec.

**À signaler aussi**
- Q3 (c) ne peut porter que sur l'identité des feuilles écrites et leur état d'initialisation : `S3` ne modélise pas les valeurs (§38).
- La spec ne dit pas quelles feuilles sont les métadonnées. J'ai pris toutes les feuilles de la valeur du pool ; c'est une lecture de ma part.
- Sur les états atteignables, la vérification de §63.4 découle déjà de §63.1 via I1 : elle ne rejette jamais un transfert à elle seule.

La conception de la bisimulation pour StaticsOK (b) tourne encore en arrière-plan. J'enchaînerai l'implémentation quand elle sera terminée.

3. **`Ren` carries no `n`.** A renaming is a bijection of `Nat` with its inverse laws.

5. **Field order is an invariant of the run, not only of `σ`.**
   - `kids` lists children in index order, and `corr` reads positions in it (§63.2).
   - The relation needs `SibMono π s.P`: `π` is increasing on siblings.
   - At init this is `ConsistentRenumbering.field_order`.
   - It is preserved because places are only appended, and appended places are fixed by `π` and larger than every older one.
   - The sketch did not carry it through runs. A renaming that breaks it changes verdicts (section 7, R1, with a run).
6. **`K.rename`:**
   - `DeclaredDisjoint` maps its lists exactly. `split` regions are arguments renamed elementwise in order, so no extensionality is needed.
   - `FreeCompat p auth` renames `p` only. §70.2 says `auth` "is opaque to the authority kernel".
   - `ExternalDone` is not renamed. Obligations keep their identities and are appended in the same order on both sides.
   - `Satisfiable p sh t := ∃ t₀, SRel π α t₀ t ∧ k.Satisfiable (π.g p) sh t₀`.
7. **Shapes are not renamed:** neither in `enter ps ls` and `alloc pr ow ls`, nor the `sh` of `Satisfiable`.
   - `ShapeOK |P| ls` forces every parent and owning element to be `≥ |P|`, where `π` is the identity.
   - `ShapeOK` depends only on `|P|` (equal on both sides) and `ls`, so rejections agree.

# Renaming bisimulation (StaticsOK point (b)): adversarial hunt

## Verdict

**No counterexample.** I found no pair of StaticsOK numberings, related by a consistent renaming that keeps field order, and no O1–O16 run where a verdict differs or where the reached states fail `s' ≈ ρ s`. This holds when K is renamed as in the sketch, with the opaque arguments handled as in point 3 of the notes below. Every index- or order-sensitive construct either is invariant or is covered by a stated hypothesis: both numberings StaticsOK, field order, or the accepted "Satisfiable is invariant under permutation" hypothesis. For each hypothesis there is a test that removes it and gets a mismatch.

## Setup (scratch, read-only on the repo)

- Harness: `RenameHunt.lean` (scratchpad). Its parts:
  - a computable `step` over the kernel's decidable preconditions and effects (Ops.lean), with verdicts ok/reject/fail;
  - `Ren` (π from σ, α induced through `rootIdx`, identity beyond) with `Ren.rho`, `Ren.inv`, `Ren.op` (renamed arguments) and `Ren.kd` (renamed K);
  - `eqv` = ≈ (F, nF, P exact; authorities exact except sorted footprints; pins exact except sorted leaves; I, dead exact and D sorted on `[0, |P|+6)`), and `eqLit` = literal equality.
- `checkAt` runs **every** candidate operation at a state pair (about 1,500–3,500 candidates: every op kind, every place/authority index plus one out of range, regions = leaf singletons and footprints, three nested local/alloc shapes, `enter` with and without params, `free p 0/1`, `unpin` on every pin id plus one). It compares verdicts and, on `ok`, checks `eqv (ρ tA) tB`.
- Config (`stA`): X{a{a1,a2}, b}, Y{c{c1,c2}, d}, Z owned by X, W, V owned by Z (13 statics, roots X Y Z W V).
- `stB` = consistent renaming σ = [6,7,10,8,9,1,2,5,3,4,11,0,12]: depth-first numbering, roots permuted, field order kept. α = [2,1,3,0,4], so the root authorities are really permuted.
- Checked: `StaticsOK stA/stB`, `isRenaming`, `fieldOrder` all `true`.
- K `d0`: shared {3,8,11}, ExternalDone {0,1,2} (pin ids), Deallocable/FreeCompat on Z, V and dynamic places, DD pairs, and Satisfiable reading the state (`|P| + |shape| ≤ bound`, provider ban).
- Renamed K: Pinned, Shared and Deallocable through π⁻¹. FreeCompat: place through π⁻¹, `auth` unchanged. ExternalDone unchanged. DD via `map π⁻¹`. Satisfiable via `k.Sat (π⁻¹ p) sh (ρ⁻¹ s')` (`Ren.inv.rho`).

| `chainF` `o < i` on parents (Basic) | invariant on StaticsOK | Parent < child in both numberings: StaticsOK for statics, `ShapeOK n` (n ≤ parent) for appended places, and no op changes `parent` (transfer changes only `owner`). Sensitive outside StaticsOK (`rh_t7`). |

## Notes for the proof (no counterexample, but they settle choices the sketch leaves open)

1. **≈ can be `List.Perm`, not only "same membership".** Every list that differs between the numberings is a permutation with the same multiplicities: the S3.init footprints, pin leaves, D lists after `movedTo`. Duplicates in D (`depend` twice) are identical in both. Taking ≈ = Perm makes the accepted hypothesis ("Satisfiable invariant under permutation of …") exactly what is needed. With ≈ = same membership, the hypothesis would also have to cover changes of multiplicity.
2. **The base case needs ≈.** `ρ(S3.init statics) = S3.init statics'` is false literally as soon as a place has a nested field before a leaf field (witness above). Only `S3.init statics' ≈ ρ(S3.init statics)` holds.
3. **K.rename must not touch the opaque arguments.** `FreeCompat`'s `auth` is opaque to the kernel (§70.2: "this identifier is opaque to the authority kernel"), and `ExternalDone` takes pin identities (§75). Rename only the place argument of `FreeCompat`. The sketch's "predicates on leaves/places through π⁻¹" does not say this. Getting it wrong gives a spurious mismatch (pitfall tests).
4. **DD is exact.** O1–O16 pass DD only the op's argument lists, renamed elementwise with order kept, so DD needs no extensionality for O1–O16. It would need it for O17–O19, because `reset` derives over a state-computed `footprint` list. That is out of scope here.

# Renaming bisimulation (StaticsOK point (b)): adversarial hunt

## Verdict

**No counterexample.** I found no pair of StaticsOK numberings, related by a consistent renaming that keeps field order, and no O1–O16 run where a verdict differs or where the reached states fail `s' ≈ ρ s`. This holds when K is renamed as in the sketch, with the opaque arguments handled as in point 3 of the notes below. Every index- or order-sensitive construct either is invariant or is covered by a stated hypothesis: both numberings StaticsOK, field order, or the accepted "Satisfiable is invariant under permutation" hypothesis. For each hypothesis there is a test that removes it and gets a mismatch.

## Setup (scratch, read-only on the repo)

- Harness: `RenameHunt.lean` (scratchpad). Its parts:
  - a computable `step` over the kernel's decidable preconditions and effects (Ops.lean), with verdicts ok/reject/fail;
  - `Ren` (π from σ, α induced through `rootIdx`, identity beyond) with `Ren.rho`, `Ren.inv`, `Ren.op` (renamed arguments) and `Ren.kd` (renamed K);
  - `eqv` = ≈ (F, nF, P exact; authorities exact except sorted footprints; pins exact except sorted leaves; I, dead exact and D sorted on `[0, |P|+6)`), and `eqLit` = literal equality.
- `checkAt` runs **every** candidate operation at a state pair (about 1,500–3,500 candidates: every op kind, every place/authority index plus one out of range, regions = leaf singletons and footprints, three nested local/alloc shapes, `enter` with and without params, `free p 0/1`, `unpin` on every pin id plus one). It compares verdicts and, on `ok`, checks `eqv (ρ tA) tB`.
- Config (`stA`): X{a{a1,a2}, b}, Y{c{c1,c2}, d}, Z owned by X, W, V owned by Z (13 statics, roots X Y Z W V).
- `stB` = consistent renaming σ = [6,7,10,8,9,1,2,5,3,4,11,0,12]: depth-first numbering, roots permuted, field order kept. α = [2,1,3,0,4], so the root authorities are really permuted.
- Checked: `StaticsOK stA/stB`, `isRenaming`, `fieldOrder` all `true`.
- K `d0`: shared {3,8,11}, ExternalDone {0,1,2} (pin ids), Deallocable/FreeCompat on Z, V and dynamic places, DD pairs, and Satisfiable reading the state (`|P| + |shape| ≤ bound`, provider ban).
- Renamed K: Pinned, Shared and Deallocable through π⁻¹. FreeCompat: place through π⁻¹, `auth` unchanged. ExternalDone unchanged. DD via `map π⁻¹`. Satisfiable via `k.Sat (π⁻¹ p) sh (ρ⁻¹ s')` (`Ren.inv.rho`).

## Tests run (output)

| Test | Result |
|---|---|
| `rh_t3`: S1 store into a deep part, depend on parts, X→Y transfer and back, endUse | all verdicts equal (10 ok); 11 states, 16166 candidates, 0 mismatch |
| `rh_t3`: S2 static→dynamic→static transfer (kids across static/dynamic), free, endUse | 5 ok in both; 6 states, 12951 candidates, 0 mismatch |
| `rh_t3`: S3 frames: params, locals, nested alloc, depend, exit | 8 ok in both; 22488 candidates, 0 mismatch |
| `rh_t3`: S4 exit reanchoring a stored authority to its first surviving origin | 8 ok in both; 15699 candidates, 0 mismatch |
| `rh_t3`: S5 pin/pin/unpin, transfer rejected (still pinned), unpin, transfer ok | identical verdicts; 9363 candidates, 0 mismatch |
| `rh_t3`: S6 split with DD on overlapping regions (`d2`) | ok/reject/reject in both; 0 mismatch |
| `rh_t3`: S7 free owned static Z, endUse X, free V (dead) | ok/ok/reject in both; 0 mismatch |
| `rh_w1`, `rh_w2`: random walks, 12 seeds × depth 10, `d0` | 120 states, 249556 candidates, 0 verdict / 0 state mismatch (all 16 ops reached ok, exit 8×, unpin 31×, transfer 2042×) |
| `rh_w3`: random walks with static pins (`d1`: Pinned {11, 3}) | 60 states, 118757 candidates, 0 / 0 |
| `rh_t5`: walks with a state-reading **extensional** Satisfiable through ρ⁻¹ (`dExt`) | 24 states, 44519 candidates, 0 / 0 |
| **Total for consistent renamings** | **254 states, ~501k candidate pairs, 0 mismatches** |

Tests that remove a hypothesis (each one gives a mismatch, as expected):

| Removed hypothesis | Test | Output |
|---|---|---|
| ≈ instead of literal ρ-equality | `eqLit (ρ (init A)) (init B)` | `false` (while `eqv` is `true`). Footprint X: A `[2,3,4]` = [b,a1,a2]; mapped `[10,8,9]`; B `[8,9,10]`. Pins after `pin X`: A leaves `[2,3,4]`, B `[8,9,10]`. `ρ⁻¹(init B)` footprints `[[3,4,2],[8,9,7],…]` vs `[[2,3,4],[7,8,9],…]` |
| Satisfiable invariant under list permutation | `dHead`: Sat reads the head of `A[0].footprint` | `alloc 11 11 [(none,0)]`: A **ok**, B **fail** |
| Field order (`rh_w4`, numbering C = B with fields a, b of X swapped; StaticsOK, renaming, not field-order) | at init, `transfer 0 5` | A **ok**, C **reject** (SameShape: a↔d by position); 7 verdict mismatches |
| StaticsOK (`rh_t7`, numbering D: a1, a2 before a; renaming + field order, not StaticsOK) | footprint X; `transfer 0 5`; `write 0 [3]` | `[2,3,4]` vs `[4]` (chainF drops the upward link); ok vs reject; ok vs reject |
| `FreeCompat`'s `auth` renamed as a place (π on both arguments) | `free 10 0` | A ok, B **reject** |
| `ExternalDone` renamed as places | `pin 0; unpin 0` | A ok, B **reject** |

## Constructs examined

| Construct (file) | Verdict | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `chainF` `o < i` on parents (Basic) | invariant on StaticsOK | Parent < child in both numberings: StaticsOK for statics, `ShapeOK n` (n ≤ parent) for appended places, and no op changes `parent` (transfer changes only `owner`). Sensitive outside StaticsOK (`rh_t7`). |
| `chainF` `o < i` on origins | invariant | Roots (permuted by α within `[0,r)`) have no origin. Derived authorities are appended (index ≥ r, α = id) with origin < self. `exitG` reanchors to an element of `ancs a`, which is smaller. |
| Fuels: `chain` = i, `corr` = r, `pframe` = \|P\|+1, Kleene = n+1 | invariant | Chain depth ≤ index in either numbering. The other fuels do not depend on indices. |
| `kids`/`posIn`/`corrF` (`p < r`)/`SameShape`/`mvTo` | invariant given field order | `kids` is in index order. Statics' siblings keep their order (field_order); appended places are fixed. A static never gets a dynamic child (`ShapeOK n`). Sensitive to field order (`rh_w4`). |
| `footprint` lists: root authorities of `S3.init`, `pinEff` leaves | **permuted, not mapped** | All consumers use membership (`∈`, `contains`, `RootHeld`'s ↔). This is why ≈ is needed. Footprints of new places from `enter`/`alloc` are literally equal (π = id there). |
| D lists, `movedTo`, `depsOf`, `movedDeps` (flatMap over parts in index order) | permuted (multiset kept) | Effects use `++`, `filter`, `map`, `flatMap`. Consumers use membership. |
| `descModes` (filterMap over authority indices), `effOf` (`= []`, `∈`) | invariant | Order-free consumers. |
| `firstSurv`/`exitG`/`exitEff`/`effAnchor` (`getLastD`) | invariant | They walk the origin chain, not index order (S4). |
| `endUse`/`free`/`cleanup`, `OwnedIn`, `Usable`, `pframe`, `ExercisableAt`, `HasRight`, `Grounds`, `RightChain` | invariant | Inductive or existential; bounds `o < \|P\|` are invariant. |
| `alloc`/`enterFrame`: new places, frames, authorities, `mapI … j ∈ ps` | invariant | New identities are lengths (equal in both). Shape parents are ≥ \|P\| ≥ n, so they need no renaming. `ps` is renamed by α. |
| `split`: order of new authorities, `rs.Pairwise`, `DeclaredDisjoint` | invariant | `rs` order is kept and each region is mapped elementwise, so DD is exact via `map π⁻¹` (S6). |
| Pins: identity = position in `pins`, `ExternalDone` | invariant | Op order is unchanged; `ExternalDone` takes ids and must **not** be renamed. |
| Equality/length/Nodup on lists: `ls ≠ []`, `rootIdx` length = 1, kids lengths, `NoOrphan` Nodup on authority chains | invariant | These apply to unrenamed shapes or to α-injective images. |
| `kind` | not read by O1–O16 | |
| `K.Satisfiable` (reads the state) | sensitive only to list order | Covered exactly by the accepted hypothesis through ρ⁻¹ (`dHead` vs `dExt`). |

## Notes for the proof (no counterexample, but they settle choices the sketch leaves open)

1. **≈ can be `List.Perm`, not only "same membership".** Every list that differs between the numberings is a permutation with the same multiplicities: the S3.init footprints, pin leaves, D lists after `movedTo`. Duplicates in D (`depend` twice) are identical in both. Taking ≈ = Perm makes the accepted hypothesis ("Satisfiable invariant under permutation of …") exactly what is needed. With ≈ = same membership, the hypothesis would also have to cover changes of multiplicity.
2. **The base case needs ≈.** `ρ(S3.init statics) = S3.init statics'` is false literally as soon as a place has a nested field before a leaf field (witness above). Only `S3.init statics' ≈ ρ(S3.init statics)` holds.
3. **K.rename must not touch the opaque arguments.** `FreeCompat`'s `auth` is opaque to the kernel (§70.2: "this identifier is opaque to the authority kernel"), and `ExternalDone` takes pin identities (§75). Rename only the place argument of `FreeCompat`. The sketch's "predicates on leaves/places through π⁻¹" does not say this. Getting it wrong gives a spurious mismatch (pitfall tests).
4. **DD is exact.** O1–O16 pass DD only the op's argument lists, renamed elementwise with order kept, so DD needs no extensionality for O1–O16. It would need it for O17–O19, because `reset` derives over a state-computed `footprint` list. That is out of scope here.

## Scratch files (all under the scratchpad)

`RenameHunt.lean` (harness), `rh_scripts.lean` + `rh_t3.lean`/`.out`, `rh_w1..4.lean`/`.out`, `rh_extra.lean` + `rh_t5.lean`/`.out`, `rh_pitfall.lean` + `rh_t6.lean`, `rh_nonok.lean` + `rh_t7.lean`.

**Incident:** the macOS file system is case-insensitive. My early `t1.lean`/`t2.lean` writes overwrote the pre-existing scratchpad files **`T1.lean` and `T2.lean`** (their names keep the uppercase of whoever created them first; they now contain my harness). If another agent owned them, their content is lost and must be regenerated. My files since then use the `rh_` prefix.

## 3. Core definitions (compiled, section 8)

Layout of `Rename/Basic.lean`: `namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access`, `namespace Rename` for `Ren`,
close it, `Holder.ren` and `Place.ren`, reopen `Rename` for the relations, close it for `K.rename`
and `KernelOp.ren`, reopen for the rest. Docstrings cite §49 last paragraph plus the clause each
definition mirrors. Everything in the block below goes in `Rename/Basic.lean`, except `Run`
(`Rename/Main.lean`) and `Renumbered`, `Renumbered.π`, `rootPerm`, `Renumbered.α`
(`Rename/Init.lean`, which imports `Statics.lean`; `Renumbered.α` comes after
`Renumbered.rootPerm_perm`).

```lean
/-- A renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): a bijection of `Nat` with its inverse. -/
structure Ren where
  f : Nat → Nat
  g : Nat → Nat
  gf : ∀ i, g (f i) = i
  fg : ∀ i, f (g i) = i

def Ren.id : Ren := ⟨fun i => i, fun i => i, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
def Ren.symm (π : Ren) : Ren := ⟨π.g, π.f, π.fg, π.gf⟩
def Ren.comp (π' π : Ren) : Ren :=
  ⟨fun i => π'.f (π.f i), fun i => π.g (π'.g i), fun i => by simp [π'.gf, π.gf],
   fun i => by simp [π'.fg, π.fg]⟩

/-- Renaming of a permutation `τ` of `List.range n`: old `x < n` goes to its position in `τ`,
new `i < n` comes from `τ[i]`; identity from `n` on. -/
def Ren.ofPerm (τ : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h : τ.Perm (List.range n)) : Ren where
  f x := if x < n then τ.idxOf x else x
  g i := if hi : i < τ.length then τ[i] else i
  gf := …   -- compiled, section 8
  fg := …

def Holder.ren (π : Ren) : Holder → Holder        -- §40, §42: frames are not renamed
  | .frame f => .frame f
  | .place p => .place (π.f p)

def Place.ren (π : Ren) (pl : Place) : Place := ⟨pl.parent.map π.f, pl.owner.ren π, pl.kind⟩

/-- Authorities related by the renaming; footprints up to permutation (§42: a set). -/
structure AuthRel (π α : Ren) (y y' : Authority) : Prop where
  mode : y'.mode = y.mode
  origin : y'.origin = y.origin.map α.f
  footprint : y'.footprint.Perm (y.footprint.map π.f)
  holder : y'.holder = y.holder.ren π
  active : y'.active = y.active

/-- Pinning obligations related by the renaming; identities kept (§74, §75). -/
structure PinRel (π : Ren) (ob ob' : PinOb) : Prop where
  place : ob'.place = π.f ob.place
  leaves : ob'.leaves.Perm (ob.leaves.map π.f)
  active : ob'.active = ob.active

/-- Place lists related by the renaming (§40); fresh identities fixed. -/
structure PRel (π : Ren) (P P' : List Place) : Prop where
  len : P'.length = P.length
  get : ∀ q, P'[π.f q]? = (P[q]?).map (Place.ren π)
  fix : ∀ q, P.length ≤ q → π.f q = q

/-- States related by place renaming `π` and authority renaming `α` (§38, §49 last paragraph);
footprints, anchors (§44: a set) and pinned leaves up to permutation. -/
structure SRel (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
  F : s'.F = s.F
  nF : s'.nF = s.nF
  P : PRel π s.P s'.P
  I : ∀ l, s'.I (π.f l) = s.I l
  Alen : s'.A.length = s.A.length
  A : ∀ x, Option.Rel (AuthRel π α) (s.A[x]?) (s'.A[α.f x]?)
  Afix : ∀ x, s.A.length ≤ x → α.f x = x
  D : ∀ q, (s'.D (π.f q)).Perm ((s.D q).map α.f)
  dead : ∀ q, s'.dead (π.f q) = s.dead q
  pins : ∀ o : Nat, Option.Rel (PinRel π) (s.pins[o]?) (s'.pins[o]?)

/-- Parent and origin links go to smaller identities (§49.2, §49.5; representation of
acyclicity, §49 last paragraph). -/
def DownP (P : List Place) : Prop := ∀ j o, parentOf P j = some o → o < j
def DownA (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ j o, s.org j = some o → o < j
def Down (s : S3) : Prop := DownP s.P ∧ DownA s

/-- `π` keeps the order of the parts of every place, their positional field order (§63.2). -/
def SibMono (π : Ren) (P : List Place) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y p, parentOf P x = some p → parentOf P y = some p → x < y → π.f x < π.f y

/-- The simulation invariant. -/
structure Sim (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
  rel : SRel π α s s'
  down : Down s
  down' : Down s'
  sib : SibMono π s.P

/-- Owner-accepted hypothesis (2026-11-06): `Satisfiable` (§71) does not distinguish states equal
up to permutation of footprint, anchor and pin-leaf lists (§42, §44). -/
def KExt (k : K) : Prop :=
  ∀ p sh s t, SRel Ren.id Ren.id s t → k.Satisfiable p sh s → k.Satisfiable p sh t

/-- The contract renamed (§48, §80); `FreeCompat`'s `auth` is opaque (§70.2); obligations keep
their identities (§75). -/
def K.rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : K where
  DeclaredDisjoint r r' := k.DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.g) (r'.map π.g)
  SharedMutable l := k.SharedMutable (π.g l)
  Pinned l := k.Pinned (π.g l)
  ExternalDone o := k.ExternalDone o
  Deallocable p := k.Deallocable (π.g p)
  FreeCompat p a := k.FreeCompat (π.g p) a
  Satisfiable p sh t := ∃ t₀, SRel π α t₀ t ∧ k.Satisfiable (π.g p) sh t₀

/-- Contracts corresponding under the renaming, `Satisfiable` excepted (§48). -/
structure KCorr (π α : Ren) (k k' : K) : Prop where
  dd : ∀ r r', k'.DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.f) (r'.map π.f) ↔ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r'
  shared : ∀ l, k'.SharedMutable (π.f l) ↔ k.SharedMutable l
  pinned : ∀ l, k'.Pinned (π.f l) ↔ k.Pinned l
  done : ∀ o, k'.ExternalDone o ↔ k.ExternalDone o
  dealloc : ∀ p, k'.Deallocable (π.f p) ↔ k.Deallocable p
  compat : ∀ p a, k'.FreeCompat (π.f p) a ↔ k.FreeCompat p a

/-- Outcomes related by the renaming (§58). -/
def OutRel (π α : Ren) : Outcome3 S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
  | .ok t, .ok t' => SRel π α t t'
  | .reject, .reject => True
  | .fail, .fail => True
  | _, _ => False

/-- Outcome relations corresponding in both directions (§58). -/
def StepCorr (π α : Ren) (R R' : Outcome3 S3 → Prop) : Prop :=
  (∀ o, R o → ∃ o', R' o' ∧ OutRel π α o o') ∧ ∀ o', R' o' → ∃ o, R o ∧ OutRel π α o o'

/-- Arguments renamed (§60–§75). Shapes are not renamed (§71.1, §72.2: fresh parents); `auth` is
opaque (§70.2); `o` is an obligation identity (§75). -/
def KernelOp.ren (π α : Ren) : KernelOp → KernelOp
  | .derive src region m => .derive (α.f src) (region.map π.f) m
  | .split src rs => .split (α.f src) (rs.map (·.map π.f))
  | .release a => .release (α.f a)
  | .transfer src dst => .transfer (π.f src) (π.f dst)
  | .depend q x => .depend (π.f q) (α.f x)
  | .enter ps ls => .enter (ps.map α.f) ls
  | .exit => .exit
  | .read a ls => .read (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
  | .write a ls => .write (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
  | .writeShared a ls => .writeShared (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
  | .pin p => .pin (π.f p)
  | .unpin o => .unpin o
  | .endUse p => .endUse (π.f p)
  | .free p auth => .free (π.f p) auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls => .alloc (π.f pr) (π.f ow) ls
  | .store a p => .store (α.f a) (π.f p)

/-- A run (§57, §58): verdicts in order; `ok` continues from its state, `reject` and `fail` from
the unchanged state. -/
inductive Run (k : K) : S3 → List KernelOp → List (Outcome3 Unit) → S3 → Prop
  | nil {s : S3} : Run k s [] [] s
  | ok {s t u : S3} {op : KernelOp} {ops : List KernelOp} {vs : List (Outcome3 Unit)} :
      op.Step k s (.ok t) → Run k t ops vs u → Run k s (op :: ops) (.ok () :: vs) u
  | reject {s u : S3} {op : KernelOp} {ops : List KernelOp} {vs : List (Outcome3 Unit)} :
      op.Step k s .reject → Run k s ops vs u → Run k s (op :: ops) (.reject :: vs) u
  | fail {s u : S3} {op : KernelOp} {ops : List KernelOp} {vs : List (Outcome3 Unit)} :
      op.Step k s .fail → Run k s ops vs u → Run k s (op :: ops) (.fail :: vs) u

/-- Two `StaticsOK` numberings of one declaration (§47; §49 last paragraph; §63.2). -/
structure Renumbered (statics : Statics) (σ : List Nat) : Prop where
  perm : σ.Perm (List.range statics.length)
  cons : ConsistentRenumbering σ statics
  ok : StaticsOK statics
  ok' : StaticsOK (renumber σ statics)

def Renumbered.π (h : Renumbered statics σ) : Ren := Ren.ofPerm σ statics.length h.perm

/-- New root authority `j'` holds the root of new root static `R'[j']`, whose old index is
`π.g R'[j']`, at old position `R.idxOf (π.g R'[j'])` (§47). -/
def rootPerm (statics : Statics) (σ : List Nat) (π : Ren) : List Nat :=
  (rootIdx ((renumber σ statics).map (·.1))).map fun i' =>
    (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).idxOf (π.g i')

def Renumbered.α (h : Renumbered statics σ) : Ren :=
  Ren.ofPerm (rootPerm statics σ h.π) _ h.rootPerm_perm
```

Conventions for every statement below: implicit `{π α : Ren} {s s' : S3} {k k' : K}`;
`h : SRel π α s s'`, `hd : Down s`, `hd' : Down s'`, `hS : Sim π α s s'`,
`hK : KCorr π α k k'`; for place lists `hP : PRel π P P'`, `hdP : DownP P`, `hdP' : DownP P'`,
`hs : SibMono π P`. "f-form" is `π.f l ∈ L' ↔ l ∈ L`; the "g-form" `l' ∈ L' ↔ π.g l' ∈ L` follows
by `Ren.mem_iff_g` (below). Every iff is proved forward and closed by symmetry.
